name: Dwayne L. Romero

summary.text: Dwayne Romero is a business owner and Army veteran from the Aspen/Basalt area running as the Democratic nominee for Colorado's 3rd Congressional District.

He served in the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers from 1984 to 1994, earned a bachelor's degree from the United States Military Academy at West Point in 1987, and an MBA from Harvard Business School in 1997.

He has served as Colorado's state director of economic development under Gov. John Hickenlooper, on the Aspen City Council, and on his local fire protection district, transit authority, and school boards.

positions.quote: A comprehensive plan means continuing to secure the border, reforming ICE and banning agents from wearing masks, hiring more immigration judges, and outlining a path to legal status for long-time, law-abiding undocumented immigrants.
